# CoverageLedger 0.3 conformance corpus

The positive cases preserve the frozen seven-stage and ordered root-chain worlds. Each root projection carries a closed, canonical name/value vector for the exact terminal branch; omission, invention, reordering, or a foreign predecessor therefore fails conformance instead of being absorbed into an opaque history object. The listed `RSCSC` and `RBCC` identities are exercised as direct single-variable falsifiers by `test_review_coverage_ledger_0_3.py`. These fixtures are validation inputs only; they do not grant composition or publication authority.
